This is hymn number 38 titled "Come, All Ye Saints of Zion" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Joseph J. Daynes and the lyrics were written by William W. Phelps.
